job: Show where an answer came from, with numbered citations and a list of sources.
purpose: Citation chips (18px mono pills) sit in the text; hovering or focusing one opens a card with the title, domain and snippet from its data attributes. A Sources list follows the answer in the same order, with a letter tile for each site. Never use a site's real logo.
useWhen: An agent's claims come from pages and the person should be able to check each one.
A chat answer needs a compact scrolling row of sources under it.

avoidWhen.when: An article footnote with no hover card.
Attribution for a quote or an author.

states.name: card open
states.how: hover or focus on .fd-citation; Escape closes

variants.useWhen: One scrolling row of compact items, as under a chat answer.
The citation card opens below the chip when there is no room above.
A tile that groups sources by kind, such as docs.
A tile for a verified or first-party source.
A tile for a distinct fourth group, such as catalog data.

parts.role: The numbered chip in the text; needs aria-label and data-title, data-domain and data-snippet.
The hover card, built by agent.js.
The number that matches the chip.

keyboard.does: Focuses a chip and shows its card.
